apps/web/src/components/motion/m.tsx.reason: Writes each MotionValue change of an m element's style in Motion's render step, with the frame's other writes: the bind ref callback subscribes each value when the element attaches and unsubscribes when it detaches, as Motion's own m components batch their writes.

apps/web/src/components/motion/scene.tsx.reason: Writes animated text (typing, counters) in Motion's render step, with the frame's other writes: the follow ref callback subscribes to the text's MotionValue when the span attaches and unsubscribes when it detaches, so React never renders per frame and a value is written once per frame.
